title: Design System: Jason Sonith — Terminal Portfolio

display.purpose: The figlet ANSI-Shadow block-letter name in the hero, scaled to viewport width so its 103-column art always fits the pane.

body.purpose: Every prompt, table, prose block, and section body across the site.

control.purpose: Buttons and command-palette items; the only medium-weight (500) text in the system.

motion.name: boot-in
motion.value: clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) -> inset(0 0 0 0); 0.32s steps(20, end) both, staggered by --i * 140ms
motion.purpose: One-shot line-by-line terminal typing reveal on first load. Disabled once html[data-boot="done"] (any keydown/pointerdown) or under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: Blinking block cursor at the end of the hero prompt. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: rain-cadence
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame loop gated to ~90ms per advance (~11fps); head glyph highlighted, trailing 4 rows at full alpha, rest at 0.82 alpha
motion.purpose: Matrix-rain canvas column (2 columns, 19px row height). Paused via IntersectionObserver (off-screen) and document.visibilitychange (hidden tab); never started under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: readme-typed
motion.value: SMIL <animate> on a clipPath rect width, calcMode discrete, ~0.025s per character
motion.purpose: Static-file equivalent of boot-in for the GitHub README's SVG banner/panels, since GitHub renders no JS/CSS beyond inline SVG+SMIL.

motion.name: readme-rain
motion.value: SMIL animateTransform translate loop, 5s and 3.6s durations on two offset columns
motion.purpose: README banner's falling-glyph column, mirroring the site's MatrixRain in a renderer with no canvas or JS.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button; starts fully inverse (phosphor fill, ground text).

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary button; transparent fill until hovered, then inverts like Primary's resting state.

components.name: Pane
components.description: A bordered pane with a command-line title bar; the recurring container for every below-the-fold section.

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Fixed, pinned-bottom, fully inverse-video primary navigation holding the four hotkey actions. Hover/focus un-inverts a single link.
components.html: [1] contact[2] resume.pdf[3] github[4] linkedin

components.name: Tab Strip
components.description: Top chrome bar: session handle + ctrl+k hint, centered certs, right-aligned live clock.

components.name: Accordion Row
components.description: ls -la-flavored disclosure row (Projects section): bracket-toggle icon, full inverse video when expanded, faint hover fill when collapsed.

components.name: Command Palette Input
components.description: Terminal-styled search field inside the Ctrl+K / '/' command dialog.

narrative.overview:
The site is not a page about a terminal; it is a session already open. A visitor lands mid-`whoami`, with a live clock ticking in the tab strip, a cursor blinking at the prompt, and a real `nmap` table listing the tools Jason actually uses as if they were open ports. The world is phosphor-on-black: one green (with three tonal steps of the same hue) on near-black, one monospace face for every character on the page — prose, tables, buttons, and headings alike — and zero corner radius anywhere. There is no card grid, no drop shadow, no gradient, no icon-driven affordance system; state and hierarchy are carried entirely by inverse video (foreground and background swap) and by dimming to a lower step of the same green.

The build carries this discipline into both surfaces it ships: the React site (src/) and the GitHub profile README, which is a set of self-contained animated SVGs (scripts/readme/svg.ts) reproducing the same palette, type, and terminal-typing motion inside a renderer that allows no JS and no external CSS.
keyCharacteristics: One hue, four steps: ground, faint, dim, full phosphor — nothing else.
One font family everywhere, including numerals and headings.
Zero border-radius, no shadows, no gradients, no glow.
Hierarchy and state read through inverse video and dimming, not size or icons.
Motion is diegetic: a boot-in typing sequence, a blinking cursor, a falling-glyph column — all skippable and all disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Every color in the system is the same green at a different lightness step (#083211 -> #089d46 -> #08f679), plus the near-black it sits on. Do not introduce a second hue for status, warning, or accent purposes.

rules.name: The Inverse-Video Rule
rules.body: "Selected" or "active" is never a new color — it is foreground and background swapping. The status bar, the expanded accordion row, and a hovered/focused button all go from phosphor-on-ground to ground-on-phosphor. No other selection treatment (border glow, background tint, checkmark color change) exists in the built system.

rules.name: The Size-Is-Not-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Do not add a size scale to signal importance. This system has one body size and one display size; everything else is color (dim vs. full phosphor) or inverse video.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no gradient, no glow exists anywhere in the shipped CSS or components. A border and, where selected, an inverse-video fill are the only depth and state cues this system has.

rules.name: The Square-Corner Rule
rules.body: --radius: 0rem, and every derived step (--radius-sm through --radius-4xl) is pinned to 0rem in src/index.css. Every bordered surface renders with hard, square corners. One unrestyled exception exists (the command palette's DialogContent still carries stock shadcn's rounded-xl) — a defect, not a sanctioned second shape language.

dos: Do keep every surface to one hue at one of four lightness steps (#080808 / #083211 / #089d46 / #08f679).
Do signal "selected" or "active" with a full foreground/background inverse-video swap, not a new color or a glow.
Do size spacing and type in vw/vh/ch/lh relative to the root clamp, not fixed px steps.
Do keep every corner square (0rem radius) on every bordered surface.
Do render disclosure and navigation affordances as bracketed text ([+]/[-], [1]-[4]) rather than icons.

Do let content render fully in the DOM before any boot/typing animation runs, and honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling .boot/.cursor animation and never starting the rain canvas's animation loop.
donts: Don't add gradients or glow — the only gradient in the codebase is the scanline overlay texture, not a decorative device, and it must stay that way.
Don't add drop shadows, elevation, or tonal surface layering; depth is border-only.
Don't round any corner; the one place it currently happens (the command palette's DialogContent, still carrying stock shadcn's rounded-xl) is a defect to fix, not a pattern to extend.
Don't introduce a second accent hue for status/warning/success — reuse the existing phosphor/dim/faint steps.
Don't reach for icon fonts or glyph icon sets; the one that has crept in (SearchIcon in the command palette input) should not be treated as license to add more.
